kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنطفئ (form VII)
# أَنْطَفِئُ (ʔanṭafiʔu) /ʔan.tˤa.fi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# أَنْطَفِئَ (ʔanṭafiʔa) /ʔan.tˤa.fi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# أَنْطَفِئْ (ʔanṭafiʔ) /ʔan.tˤa.fiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
